start: Demo gym as the owner; Messages & offers, section "Automatic reminders"

user_sees: The reminder rows, with plan ends soon, plan ends today, plan ended, birthday, welcome, miss you and low PT sessions switched on
must_not: "Automatic reminders are not switched on for your gym yet."

steps.action: Switch one reminder off and change a days box
must_not: The change saved before pressing Save

user_sees: "Saving…" then "Saved. Members' phones pick this up the next time they open MettleUp."
The rows keep the new values; "Save changes" greyed again
must_not: A real reminder sent to anyone

steps.action: Open Messages & offers and scroll to "Automatic reminders"
must_not: A save that works for the desk

start: Demo gym as the owner; "Automatic reminders" open

steps.action: Empty the days box of a reminder that is on, or type a number outside its range
user_sees: An error under that row in plain words; "Save changes" greyed out
must_not: A reminder saved with no days
The other rows blocked without a reason

start: Demo gym as the owner; a reminder changed but not saved

user_sees: The rows go back to the last saved values; "Undo changes" disappears

steps.action: Change it again, tap "Save changes", leave the screen and come back
user_sees: The saved values are still there in this visit
must_not: The seeded values back without a refresh
The saved change kept after the refresh

steps.action: Read the saved line and the preview words of a reminder
user_sees: The sample gym name in the preview; the saved-by name is a made-up person
must_not: A reminder really sent to a phone
